notes.title: Tense your muscles and join the Hercules squad!
notes.content:
Do you want to play the newest JetDogs strategy games before they are released? Are you ready to generate ideas that will be heard? Do you want to get great respect from us and community? Are you well-skilled Hercules player? Then you’re the one we’re looking for!
 
Requirements:

    Good command of English/Russian
    Be the huge fun of Hercules-style games
    Have at least 3 Hercules games in your account with ALL achievements unlocked.

Duties:

    Play JetDogs strategy games before release
    Help to improve them 
    Report bugs and suggest ideas

Write to contact@jetdogs.com if you want to join. Do not forget to put your steam account link inside a mail.
